auth.choose-code-channel: Choose where to receive your code — WhatsApp or Telegram.
auth.password-save-failed: Signed in, but saving your password failed ({v0}). Set one on My Profile so you can sign in with it next time.
auth.password-too-short: Your password must be at least 8 characters.
capture.camera-access-required: Camera access is required — Hawkeye only accepts live photos. If you denied it, allow Camera for this site (tap the padlock/ⓘ icon by the address bar → Permissions) and try again.
collation.no-gps-fix-retake: No GPS fix — move to open sky and retake.
flag.send-failed: Could not send the report — check your connection and try again.
flag.title: Report this content
flag.why: Tell us what is wrong with it. A moderator reviews every report.
observe.no-gps-fix-retake: No GPS fix — photos must be location-stamped. Move to open sky and retake.
observe.telegram-sign-in-failed: Telegram sign-in did not complete — you can use the SMS option below.
practice.no-camera-sample-photo: No camera available — using a sample photo for practice.
profile.delete-confirm-body: Your key, device binding, Telegram link and subscriptions are wiped. Ledger reports stay (they are public and permanent).
ready.all-set: You are ready for election day.
ready.approximate: Only approximate location is allowed. Turn on Precise location.
ready.blocked-browser: Blocked — allow it in your browser’s settings for this site.
ready.blocked-phone: Blocked — allow it for Hawkeye in your phone’s Settings.
ready.no-camera: No camera found on this device.
ready.no-location: This browser cannot share your location.
ready.title: Ready for election day
situation-room.race-not-in-register: That race is not in the register.
